item.title: Sunteck Realty H1FY27 net profit rises 20%, pre-sales up 19%
item.description: Sunteck Realty recorded a net profit of Rs 99 crore in the first half of FY27. Revenue increased 16% to Rs 512 crore, reflecting strong business growth during this period. Pre-sales also rose to Rs 1,611 crore, showing continued demand for properties. The company made significant investments in business development, acquiring land in Borivali. Overall, Sunteck's growth indicators continue to strengthen as they prepare for future projects.

item.title: Dalmia Bharat posts Rs 205 crore Q2 loss on exceptional hit
item.description: Dalmia Bharat experienced a consolidated loss of Rs 205 crore in the September quarter of this year. This loss was due to an exceptional hit of Rs 339 crore related to asset impairment and employee separation. Sales volume rose by 3% year-on-year, while consolidated revenue increased by 4% to Rs 3,563 crore. However, EBITDA fell by 29% due to rising power and fuel costs, which increased by 22%.

item.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
item.description: Indian stock markets saw a notable recovery after early losses on Monday. Sensex rose nearly 483 points, while Nifty gained over 153 points during the trading session. This rebound followed a four-day decline that significantly impacted investor wealth. Analysts noted value buying supported the recovery, particularly in sectors like power, healthcare, and metals. Despite this, caution prevailed due to geopolitical uncertainties and upcoming policy decisions from major global banks.

item.title: Paytm Q2 Results: Profit rockets 976% YoY to Rs 226 crore, revenue jumps 28%
item.description: Paytm Q2 Results: Fintech major Paytm on Monday reported 976% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 226 crore. The same stood at Rs 21 crore in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations in the reporting period rose 28% YoY to Rs 2,648 crore.

item.title: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 42% to record Rs 451 crore on high net interest income
item.description: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank has set a remarkable milestone with a net profit of Rs 451 crore for the quarter from July to September. This success is buoyed by a substantial rise in interest income, totaling Rs 1,820 crore compared to the same period last year. Managing Director Salee Sukumaran Nair emphasized the role of net interest income in driving this profit.

item.title: Indian Overseas Bank to raise $500 million as Q2 profit jumps 56%
item.description: Indian Overseas Bank plans to raise $500 million through external commercial borrowings in two tranches by December. The lender reported a 56% rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,912 crore, alongside stronger credit growth and improved asset quality.

item.title: MMT reports net profit of $1.8 million in Q2, revenues at $ 235.2 million
item.description: MakeMyTrip reported a $1.8 million Q2 net profit, reversing a year-earlier loss of $5.7 million. Revenue rose 11.2% to $235.2 million, while gross bookings grew 20.9%, supported by hotels, transport and AI-powered travel assistant Myra.

item.title: Bank of Maharashtra Q2 profit jumps 41.5% as bad loans decline
item.description: Bank of Maharashtra posted a 41.5% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 2,310 crore, supported by stronger income, deposit and credit growth, improved asset quality and a return on assets of 2.02%.

item.title: The Rs 1.5 lakh crore MTF problem: How shrinking leveraged positions are deepening India's smallcap sell-off
item.description: India’s smallcap sell-off is intensifying as margin trading facility (MTF) positions decline from record levels. With nearly Rs 72,000 crore exposed to smallcaps, forced liquidations could deepen losses, although SEBI safeguards may limit systemic risks.

item.title: Yes Bank among 6 stocks to hit 52-week lows and fall up to 32% in a month
item.description: Despite the Sensex gaining 483 points to close at 73,606, six BSE 100 stocks hit fresh 52-week lows. Yes Bank led monthly declines, followed by Power Finance Corporation, Tata Power, Canara Bank, Tata Consumer Products and Godrej Consumer Products.

item.title: Tata Consumer Q2 Results: Net profit rises 16% YoY to Rs 470 crore, revenue up 14%
item.description: Tata Consumer Products reported a 16% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 470 crore in Q2 FY27, with revenue rising 14% to Rs 5,661 crore. Strong Indian volumes, salt demand and growth businesses boosted performance, while EBITDA increased 18% to Rs 794 crore.

item.title: ITC Hotels reports revenues of Rs 1054 cr for Q2, PAT at Rs 203 cr
item.description: ITC Hotels reported strong second-quarter growth, with revenue rising 26% and net profit increasing 52% year on year, supported by higher room rates, occupancy and demand from business events. The company also expanded its portfolio through new hotel signings, the Welcomhotel Ahmedabad acquisition and a land allotment in Lucknow.

item.title: Market wrap: Dr Reddys, JSW Steel, Shriram Finance, Tata Consumer top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
item.description: Indian equity markets snapped a four-day losing streak as Sensex and Nifty rebounded, supported by broad-based buying. Dr Reddy’s and JSW Steel led gainers, while rising India VIX signalled continued volatility and technical concerns about downside risks.

item.title: Global Market: European shares flat as investors assess earnings, France turmoil
item.description: European shares traded flat as investors weighed corporate earnings and political uncertainty in France. Falling oil prices, driven by hopes of easing US-Iran tensions, supported travel and leisure stocks, while energy shares declined.

item.title: Ather Energy shares skyrocket 19% after EV maker swings to Rs 1.26 crore profit in Q2
item.description: Ather Energy shares surged nearly 19% after the electric two-wheeler maker reported a net profit of Rs 1.26 crore in Q2 FY27, reversing a loss of Rs 154 crore a year earlier. Revenue rose 62.8% year-on-year to Rs 1,464 crore, while the company also approved Rs 122 crore in capacity expansion.

item.title: SoftBank sells 1.21 crore Ola Electric rights entitlements as EV maker seeks to raise Rs 1,000 crore
item.description: SoftBank sold nearly 28% of its Ola Electric rights entitlements over two sessions as the company launched a Rs 1,000-crore rights issue. Meanwhile, Motilal Oswal entities applied for 2.39 crore shares amid declining revenue and persistent losses.

item.title: Michael Burry's top 10 life lessons for GenZ: 'Buy half the house you can afford'
item.description: Michael Burry provides life advice and personal finance tips to a 26-year-old in a Substack post. He emphasizes the importance of exercising, learning, and relationships while advising against gambling. Burry suggests that individuals should invest wisely, specifically recommending to buy half a house they can afford. He warns about the potential for an AI market crash, predicting possible disappointments in revenue.

item.title: FIIs raise stakes after two quarters of cuts; 8 stocks rally up to 135% in 3 months
item.description: Foreign institutional investors turned net buyers in select stocks in the September 2026 quarter after two quarters of reduced exposure. Morepen Laboratories, Shanti Gold International and other stocks gained up to 135% over three months.

item.title: Swiggy shares jump 5% a day after Q2 results sparked a 17% crash. Why brokerages remain bullish despite target price cuts
item.description: Swiggy shares rebounded nearly 5% after plunging 17% following its Q2FY27 results. While food delivery profitability improved, widening Instamart losses prompted Jefferies and Nomura to cut target prices, even as brokerages retained bullish ratings.

item.title: BSE shares jump over 4% as Motilal Oswal upgrades stock to Buy. 4 reasons behind bullish call
item.description: BSE shares rose sharply on Monday after Motilal Oswal upgraded the stock to Buy with a target price of Rs 4,000, implying 23% upside. The brokerage expects strong derivatives volumes, rising premium turnover, improving cash market participation and operating leverage to drive revenue growth, margin expansion and a 27% profit CAGR through FY28.

item.title: Apollo Micro Systems shares rally 9% as Q2 net profit jumps 56% YoY
item.description: Apollo Micro Systems has reported an impressive rise in Q2 earnings, with net profit soaring by 56% compared to last year. Revenues spiked 72%, hitting a milestone of Rs 388 crore for the September quarter. The notable increase in EBITDA showcases solid operational efficiency in the defence sector. The company is dedicated to enhancing its capabilities and expanding into global markets, demonstrating a strategic focus on its future objectives.

item.title: What Bitcoin ETF flows reveal about institutional confidence
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded volatile inflows and outflows, reflecting uneven investor conviction. Although demand recovered during the third quarter, ETF flows have largely followed Bitcoin’s price movements rather than predicted them, making sustained trends more significant than daily fluctuations.

item.title: Tonbo Imaging shares soar another 17% after a 64% listing pop. Buy, sell or hold the stock?
item.description: Tonbo Imaging shares rallied after a strong stock market debut, following heavy demand for its IPO. Investors will track revenue growth, order execution, profitability, working capital and cash flows to assess the defence electronics company’s long-term prospects.

item.title: $7.7 trillion AI bet: Can hyperscalers earn enough to justify the spending?
item.description: Six major hyperscalers are projected to spend $7.7 trillion on AI between 2026 and 2030, but generating adequate returns will be a challenge. UBS estimates they need $1 trillion in additional earnings before interest and taxes by 2031. The key questions are whether AI boosts productivity and companies can monetise those gains.

item.title: Bharat Coking Coal shares rally 5% after Q2 profit turnaround; revenue jumps 39% YoY
item.description: Bharat Coking Coal shares sharply on Monday after the Coal India subsidiary reported a turnaround to profit in Q2 FY27, with net profit at Rs 123.7 crore and revenue up 39% year-on-year to Rs 4,412.58 crore. However, first-half production declined, while technical indicators pointed to continued weakness in the stock.

item.title: Sensex jumps 1,100 pts from day’s low, Nifty closes above 22,750 as D-St rebounds after 4-day losses. Is this relief rally sustainable?
item.description: On Monday, the Indian stock market experienced a notable rebound, with the Sensex and Nifty indices recovering about 2% after previous declines. Major players like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Adani Ports contributed to this surge, boosting investor confidence. However, analysts caution against potential risks due to rising crude oil prices and economic uncertainties, indicating that while there's room for recovery, careful stock selection remains essential.

item.title: AU Small Finance Bank shares tumble 10% after Q2 results, but Jefferies and Motilal see up to 37% upside
item.description: AU Small Finance Bank shares fell up to 10% despite a 53% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit. Jefferies and Motilal Oswal retained Buy ratings, citing growth prospects, improving asset quality and lower credit costs.

item.title: Shriram Finance shares crash 6% as Jefferies, Citi, and other brokerages slash target prices after Q2 results. Why do they still say ‘Buy’?
item.description: Shriram Finance shares fell sharply on Monday after Jefferies, Citi and Motilal Oswal cut their target prices following the NBFC’s Q2 results. Despite concerns over rising credit costs and rural stress, all three brokerages retained their ‘Buy’ ratings, citing strong net interest income, resilient margins and long-term growth potential.

item.title: Paras Healthcare allotment likely today: Check GMP, key details and how to check status
item.description: Paras Healthcare IPO allotment is expected to be finalised today after the Rs 1,450-crore issue was subscribed 2.23 times. With the GMP indicating a potential listing gain of around 1%, investors can check their allotment status on the MUFG Intime, NSE and BSE websites. The hospital chain is scheduled to list on October 28, 2026, after reporting a return to profitability in FY26.

item.title: Coforge slips 3% even as Jefferies, Nomura, others raise targets after Q2 earnings. Why are they bullish?
item.description: Coforge shares fell despite strong Q2 results and brokerages raising target prices. Net profit surged 56.5% year-on-year to Rs 588.1 crore, while revenue jumped 54% to Rs 6,170.8 crore. EBITDA rose 67% to Rs 1,269.7 crore, with margins expanding 168 basis points to 20.6%. The company raised its FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%, while its 12-month order book grew 45% to $2.38 billion.

Infosys shares fall 4% after IT major lowers FY27 guidance. What are Goldman Sachs, Nomura, others saying?
item.description: Infosys shares fell sharply on Monday after the IT major cut its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1-2% from 1.5-3%, citing pricing pressure and a challenging demand environment. While Nomura remains bullish, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Citi and Choice Institutional Equities flag growth concerns, with differing ratings and target prices.

item.title: Asian Paints Share Price Highlights: Asian Paints Stock Price History
Kotak Mahindra Bank shares climb 4% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, Goldman Sachs saying?
item.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported strong Q2FY27 earnings, with consolidated profit rising 26% year-on-year. Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, Motilal Oswal and Nuvama maintained Buy ratings, citing growth prospects and improving earnings outlook.

item.title: Tech picks: Anand Rathi, Cyient among 5 stocks to buy for up to 18% returns in short term
item.description: Amid market volatility, investors are becoming more discerning in their stock selections. Anand Rathi, JSW Cement, and Firstsource Solutions are flagged for promising short-term profits. Additionally, Cyient and Ipca Laboratories showcase robust technical indicators, presenting themselves as compelling choices. With significant corporate earnings reports on the horizon, market trends are expected to shift. Analysts advise keeping an eye on these stocks to identify prime entry points and lucrative prospects.

item.title: IndusInd Bank shares rise 2% after Q2 results. Why Jefferies cut target price despite lender swinging to profit
item.description: IndusInd Bank announced a net profit of Rs 1,176 crore for the quarter ending September 2027. The bank's asset quality improved with gross non-performing assets declining to 2.73% from 3.6% a year earlier. Jefferies adjusted its target price for the bank's shares down to Rs 1,130 due to changing credit cost expectations. Motilal Oswal maintained a neutral stance with a target price of Rs 1,050, indicating a positive outlook.

item.title: UltraTech Cem Share Price Highlights: UltraTech Cem. Stock Price History
Nifty's PEG ratio near 10-year low but why don't stocks look cheap yet? Valuation paradox explained
item.description: Nifty’s PEG ratio approaches a decade low, suggesting an enticing potential for valuation and earnings growth. The substantial drop in the forward P/E ratio has heightened hopes for a market recovery. However, rising bond yields and potential earnings downgrades pose challenges to investor sentiment. Selective opportunities arise across sectors, influenced by enhanced credit growth and evolving demand.

item.title: NTPC Share Price Highlights: NTPC Stock Price History
FSN E-Commerce Ventures among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
item.description: As of October 23, five NSE F&O stocks recorded more than 7% growth in futures open interest, signalling increased trader participation and fresh position-building. FSN E-Commerce Ventures and Godfrey Phillips India led the list with 10.88% increases each, followed by CG Power, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank and Siemens Energy India.
